name: linux-camera
description: Простое приложение камеры для Linux: фото, видео, зум, ночной режим / Simple camera app for Linux
readme_summary: Linux Camera is a simple, lightweight camera application for Linux written in Python. It provides essential features like taking photos, recording videos, digital zoom, image adjustments, and a night mode, all without heavy dependencies.
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly and functional camera application for Linux desktops, enabling basic photography and videography tasks with easy-to-use controls and minimal system requirements.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot holding a vintage camera, actively capturing a scene. The robot's lens is emitting a beam of light that transforms into a digital photo frame on one side and a video reel on the other, clearly showing the dual output. Subtle UI elements like sliders for zoom and brightness are visible on the robot's arm. The background is a clean, minimalist Linux desktop environment. The overall mood is helpful and accessible, with a clean, modern illustration style and a vibrant color palette. The repository name 'linux-camera' is subtly integrated into the robot's design or a small screen element.

name: kudu
description: Free Windows, Mac and Linux cleaner, scanner, and more.
readme_summary: Kudu is a free, open-source system utility for Windows, macOS, and Linux that optimizes performance, enhances privacy, and improves security. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for cleaning temporary files, managing startup applications, scanning for malware, and configuring system settings.
primary_use_case: System cleaning, optimization, security scanning, and privacy enhancement across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, robotic librarian meticulously organizing a vast, cluttered digital library. The librarian uses a glowing scanner to identify and remove corrupted data 'books' and malware 'critters' from shelves, while simultaneously tidying up scattered digital 'papers' (temporary files). Successfully cleaned sections of the library glow with a clean, organized light. Subtle UI elements showing Kudu's logo and scan progress are visible on a nearby console. The scene is set in a bright, modern digital space with a clean, isometric 3D illustration style, emphasizing order and efficiency.

name: LiveContainer
description: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!
readme_summary: LiveContainer is an app launcher for iOS that allows users to run multiple applications without needing to install each one individually. It bypasses typical app installation limits and can manage different versions of apps with separate data containers.
key_features: Run iOS apps without installing them
Install unlimited apps with a single app ID
Support for multiple versions of an app with separate data containers
Bypass codesign requirements when JIT is available (iOS < 26)
App signing with LiveContainer's certificate when JIT is not available
primary_use_case: To enable users to run and manage multiple iOS applications, including different versions, without the constraints of traditional installation methods and developer account limitations.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of a user's iPhone screen, but instead of individual app icons, there's a single, large, glowing 'LiveContainer' icon. From this central icon, multiple smaller, distinct app windows (like mini-apps) are elegantly emerging and floating around it, each representing a different application. A subtle digital stream flows from the main icon into each mini-app, symbolizing the 'running without installing' concept. The background is clean and modern, with soft, ethereal light. The overall mood is one of freedom and expanded possibility. 3D isometric illustration style, clean lines, bright and inviting color palette.

name: RuView
description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
readme_summary: RuView is a Rust-based platform that transforms ordinary WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence and vital sign monitoring. It uses low-cost ESP32 sensors to detect presence, track movement, measure breathing and heart rate, and even recognize activities, all without cameras or wearables.
key_features: Real-time spatial intelligence and sensing through WiFi signals
Contactless vital sign monitoring (breathing and heart rate)
Edge computing on ESP32 mesh hardware
Local learning with spiking neural networks
Integration with smart home ecosystems (Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, Matter)
No cloud, cameras, or internet required
primary_use_case: To provide non-intrusive, camera-free sensing of human presence, activity, and vital signs within an environment by leveraging existing WiFi infrastructure.
cover_image_prompt: A conceptual illustration of a WiFi router acting as a benevolent eye, emitting gentle, invisible waves that pass through walls. Inside the walls, faint, ethereal outlines of people are visible, showing their postures and even subtle indications of breathing. One outline is clearly sleeping, another is standing, and a third is falling. Small, glowing data points representing vital signs like heart rate and breathing patterns float around these outlines. In the foreground, a subtle, minimalist interface displays 'Presence Detected' and 'Vitals Monitored'. The overall mood is serene and futuristic, with a clean, blue and white color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and clear, abstract forms.
